# SIGIL SARL

> Sovereign Integrity Governance Infrastructure Labs (SIGIL SARL) is a Cameroonian company based in Buea, Cameroon, building sovereign governance infrastructure for public institutions: systems where the institution holds the keys, the data never leaves, and every consequential action is authorized, bounded, and proven. Founded and led by Junior Thuram Nana.

## Systems

- [VIGIL](https://sigilsovereign.com/systems/vigil/): Governed cybersecurity and evidence platform. Status: pre-deployment. Source code: kept strictly private.
- [RÉCOR](https://sigilsovereign.com/systems/recor/): Sovereign beneficial-ownership registry. Status: pre-deployment. Source code: kept strictly private.
- [APEX](https://sigilsovereign.com/systems/apex/): Anti-corruption intelligence for public procurement. Status: pre-deployment. Source code: kept strictly private.

## Doctrine

- A technical capability is never an authorization.
- No finding is trusted until an independent, deterministic check re-verifies it.
- The institution always holds the keys and can read, export, and stop.
- Open standards over lock-in.

## System detail

### VIGIL

VIGIL is a cybersecurity platform that helps duly authorized operators find, confirm, remediate, and document vulnerabilities — under one rule: a technical capability is never an authorization. No model or agent can authorize itself, and no finding is trusted until an independent, re-verifiable check confirms it.

Standards: OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST 800-115, PTES, PASTA. Status: pre-deployment. Source code: kept strictly private.

### RÉCOR

RÉCOR is a sovereign beneficial-ownership registry designed for Cameroon, built to satisfy FATF Recommendations 24 and 25 and to export to the Beneficial Ownership Data Standard (BODS v0.4). It was fully demonstrated to Open Ownership on 1 July 2026, confirming its conformance.

Standards: FATF R.24, FATF R.25, BODS v0.4. Status: pre-deployment. Source code: kept strictly private.

### APEX

APEX reads public data — procurement notices, sanctions lists, corporate registries, court records, and citizen tips — detects defined patterns of procurement fraud, and scores each finding with a calibrated certainty engine. No single person can escalate a case: a five-member council, each holding a hardware key, must reach quorum, and every finding is independently verifiable against a public ledger without trusting the platform. It compiles evidence and signals confidence; a human institution makes every consequential decision.

Standards: UNCAC, OCDS. Status: pre-deployment. Source code: kept strictly private.
